mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation_detail (item_id, item_quantity, item_amount) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{itemQuantity}, #{itemAmount})
mapper.select: select i.item_name, rd.item_quantity, rd.item_amount,rd.item_id from reservation_detail rd join items i on rd.item_id = i.item_id where res_id = #{resId}

select rd.res_id, rd.item_id, rd.item_quantity, rd.item_amount, i.item_name, i.item_img from reservation_detail rd join items i on rd.item_id = i.item_id where rd.res_id = (select res_id from reservation_master where user_id = #{userId}) order BY rd.item_id ASC
mapper.delete: delete from reservation_detail where res_id in (select res_id from reservation_master where user_id = #{userId})
